problems.note: Card 7 reads 'Nice work, Sam is ready.' The comma splice is awkward to hear aloud. Consider 'Nice work! Sam is ready, and now it is your turn to read and build numbers up to 10 000.'

The narration 'Move the frog to 4000' does not tell a child who only hears the audio where the line starts and ends, or how far each jump is. Have the narration or screen read aloud the scale, e.g. 'The line goes from 0 to 10 000. Move the frog to 4000.'
Same issue as number-line-1. The 0 to 10 000 range and the step of 500 should be spoken, so a child using sound alone can work out the position of 6500.
Same issue. The line runs from 4000 to 5000 in steps of 50. Without hearing that range, a child using sound alone cannot tell where 4650 is.

output.notes: Checked every story card and item. All marked answers are correct, and no item has more than one correct choice or is missing its right answer.
